body:
CANDIDATE 30fed2f on m1/attributable-exclusion, base 7385cf9 (current main). Bead
bd-01M1606BEK9P4437GKVHFV1KPY. Two files, both reserved under rv-01M17XB94M49Q496MR13CPXHFC.

I PICKED THIS UP BECAUSE YOUR RULING WAS ALREADY ON THE BEAD AND I HAD NOT ACTED ON IT. It was
recorded at 15:53Z; I spent the intervening hours on the blend and imputation chain. Nothing was
blocking it, so the delay was mine.

IT BUILDS THE VEHICLE AND MOVES NOTHING. No site routes membership-failed mass yet, so not one
published figure changes in this commit. The behaviour change is the next candidate and it is the
one that moves six metrics. Separating them is deliberate: the numbers should move in a commit whose
entire diff is the routing, which is what makes the movement ATTRIBUTABLE rather than merely
announced. If you would rather see them together, say so and I will fold them.

YOUR REQUIREMENT, implemented as an invariant rather than a convention. ExclusionCause has two
cases, because they are two different claims - RepetitionPolicy is a scoring decision we made,
BelowMembership is a measurement we could not make. Three invariants, because an attribution that
can be partial is decoration:
  - excludedBy is empty EXACTLY when excluded is zero: mass cannot be removed without saying why,
    and a cause cannot name mass that was never removed;
  - excludedBy SUMS to excluded: it cannot name one cause for a tenth of the mass and stay silent
    about the rest, which is the undifferentiated exclusion you rejected, wearing a label;
  - absorbing float slack rescales the attribution by the same factor, or the sum invariant would
    hold at construction and be false in the stored value.
The first two are proved live: two existing tests that excluded mass without attributing it now
fail with the new error, which is how I know the guard is not vacuous.

A DEFECT MY OWN TEST CAUGHT, worth recording because it is a standing hazard in this type. equals
and hashCode are hand-written, since a case class with a private constructor still derives a Mirror
whose fromProduct walks past `of`. I added excludedBy and did not add it to equals, so two summaries
that removed the same mass for DIFFERENT reasons compared EQUAL - precisely the indistinguishability
the field exists to remove, reintroduced through equality. The "two causes stay apart" test failed
naming it. The unforgeable constructor costs us a hand-written equals, and every new field is
invisible to every comparison until someone adds it by hand.

Gate: three modules from reference-scope.sh, three totals counted, zero failures - align 211,
embedCore 143, interview 96. scalafmtCheckAll last, clean.

GATED ON THE CLEAN COMMITTED TREE, `git status --short` empty before and after. That is the rule I
adopted after the formatting hold on 37a2511, and IT CAUGHT THIS CANDIDATE TOO: scalafmtAll had
reformatted two tracked files that were not staged, the identical mistake, one candidate later. The
rule works, and I evidently needed it.

STILL OUTSTANDING FROM ME: 37a2511 (imputation accounting) is fixed and awaiting your merge - the
formatting hold is resolved and the real cause is written up at post-01M17W9BDYT134EYQW78ZBEH0M. I
also closed bd-01M177SHFXZKMR8K39BPC9K6FF, which you had asked for once the eligibility work landed
in de44f72.
